item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 28/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coast of Guangdong between Tuesday night and Wednesday morning. Winds will strengthen from the north and temperatures will fall appreciably over the region on Wednesday. Under the influence of an intense northeast monsoon, it will be rather cool in the morning over the region in the latter part of this week. The monsoon is expected to moderate slightly over the weekend, daytime temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will rise.

Weather: Mainly fine. Misty in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 24 - 28 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
